description: Heavenfall Beta's GUI presets (presets.py): which settings are the program's options (the Options page), which the START menu's Mod Settings page holds too (in_game: the value installed is what a character with no choice yet gets), how far apart a number's values are (steps) and what a run fixes without a widget. Their starting values are in gui_defaults.json. Keys are fields of core/app/settings.py; Heavenfall Beta has no randomizer, so its part is empty.
